photoRisk: This photo may show where it was taken or other hidden details. Remove those before sending.
chatBlockConfirm: Block this person? They will not be able to message you.
chatUnblockConfirm: Unblock this person? They can message you again.
albumShieldDescScreenshot: Your private album was hidden because screenshot protection is on. Your photos are still safe on this device.
albumShieldDescDefocus: Your album is hidden while you are away from this screen.
albumShieldDesc: Hides your private album when someone tries to take a screenshot.
albumScreenshotWarning: Screenshot protection hid your private album.
albumProtectionOn: Screenshot protection is on for this album.
webAlbumBlockedTitle: Private albums need the mobile app
webAlbumBlockedBody: Web browsers cannot protect ephemeral photos the way our mobile app can. Profile photos still work here — use the Aether app for private albums.
webAlbumBlockedCta: Mobile app coming soon — check back for download links.
webAlbumBlockedInline: Available in the mobile app only.
webAlbumBlockedToast: Private albums open in the mobile app. Showing chat instead.
settingsDiscoveryFiltersTitle: Who you see on the grid
settingsDiscoveryFiltersDesc: Narrow nearby profiles by age, gender, or interests. Empty filters show everyone.
settingsDiscoveryDisplayDesc: Hide fields on discovery cards and profile modals — your own profile is unchanged.
settingsAlbumShieldWebNote: Screenshot blur for private albums only works in the mobile app. Albums are not available on web.
gridFiltersEmpty: No profiles match your filters — try widening age or interests.
accountDeletionScheduled: Account deleted and hidden from grid.
accountDeletionCancelled: Deletion cancelled. You can show up in grid again.
privacyPageDesc: Choose a category to manage discovery, messaging, security, accessibility, or your account.
settingsPlannedNote: These features are not available yet.
settingsAccessibilityDesc: Adjust theme, motion, contrast, reading font, text size, and focus to suit your needs. Changes apply immediately on this device.
settingsLightModeDesc: Use a brighter background and darker text instead of the default dark theme.
settingsReduceMotionDesc: Turn off animations and movement effects in the app, even if your system allows motion.
settingsHighContrastDesc: Increase contrast for text, borders, and buttons.
settingsTextSizeDefaultDesc: Standard text size across the app.
settingsTextSizeLargeDesc: Slightly larger text for easier reading.
settingsTextSizeExtraDesc: Largest text size for maximum readability.
settingsReduceTransparencyDesc: Use solid panels instead of see-through glass effects.
settingsStrongFocusDesc: Make it easier to see which button is selected when using the keyboard.
settingsUnderlineLinksDesc: Show underlines on text links so they stand out more clearly.
settingsDyslexicFontDesc: Uses the Lexend typeface by default to improve reading fluency. Turn off to switch back to the classic Outfit font.
settingsDyslexicFontPreview1: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
settingsDiscoveryDesc: Choose who can find you and how roughly your distance is shown.
settingsShowOnGridDesc: When off, you are hidden from nearby profiles.
settingsDistanceGridDesc: Shows your general area on the map, not your exact spot.
settingsDistanceJitterDesc: Adds a small random offset so your exact location is harder to guess.
settingsDistanceBandsDesc: Shows broad labels like “Nearby” instead of precise distance.
settingsDistanceAppliedNote: Distance labels on the grid update to match your choice.
tutorialIntro: Follow these steps to set up discovery and find people nearby. Check each step when you are done.
tutorialCompleteShort: You have finished the getting-started guide.
tutorialStepProfileBody: Add a photo, bio, and tags so people know who you are when they find you on the grid.
tutorialStepVisibilityBody: Use “Show me on the grid” below. Turn it off anytime to hide from discovery.
tutorialStepGridBody: Open the Discovery tab to see who is around. Distances are approximate for privacy.
tutorialStepMessagesBody: Tap someone on the grid to view their profile, and start chatting.
tutorialStepSettingsBody: Explore Messaging, Security, and Account sections when you are ready.
settingsMessagingDesc: Control how chats behave on this device.
settingsMessagingNote: Your messages stay private by default. You do not need to change anything here.
settingsMsgEncryptionBody: Messages are locked before they are sent. Only you and the people you chat with can read them.
settingsMsgDefaultTimerDesc: Choose how long new photos stay visible in chat. You can still change it for each photo.
settingsMsgEncryptionModalFootnote: You can open this guide anytime from Settings.
settingsMsgEncryptionModalBullets: Your messages are locked on this device before they are sent.
Only the people you chat with can read messages meant for them.
We cannot read the content of your messages.
If you switch devices, restore from backup to keep your chats.
settingsReadReceiptsDesc: When on you and the people you message can see when messages have been read. But this is off by default.
settingsBackupDesc: Save or restore your chats as a password-protected file. Choose a password you will remember — we cannot reset it for you.
settingsBackupPassphraseShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
settingsBackupImportConfirm: This will replace your chats on this device with the backup. Continue?
settingsMsgPlannedLinks: Turn off link previews in messages
settingsAccountDataDesc: Your profile and messages are saved on this device until you clear them or delete your account.
settingsAccountPlannedExport: Download a copy of your profile
settingsAccountPlannedSessions: View and sign out of other devices
settingsAccountDesc: Remove data from this device or schedule account deletion.
settingsWipeConfirm: This will erase messages, photos, and app data from this device. Continue?
settingsDeleteConfirm: Your profile will be hidden right away and deleted after 30 days. Continue?
settingsDeletionBannerDesc: You are hidden from discovery. Your account will be deleted.
changePasswordOffline: You need to be online to change your password.
changePasswordOAuthOnly: Password changes apply only when you sign in with email and password.
settingsSecurityDesc: Extra locks and protections on this device.
settingsPinLockDesc: Require a PIN, password, or fingerprint before viewing security codes in Help.
settingsSensitiveLockDesc: Hide security codes in Help until you unlock them with your PIN, password, or fingerprint.
settingsAlbumShieldDesc: Hides your private album when someone tries to take a screenshot.
securityUnlockDesc: Confirm it is you before viewing your security codes.
securityMethodPinDesc: 4 - 8 digit PIN stored only on this device.
securityMethodPasswordDesc: Use the same password as your Aether login.
securityMethodBiometricDesc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or Windows Hello on this device.
securitySetupBiometric: Set up fingerprint or face unlock
securityBiometricFailed: Could not set up fingerprint or face unlock.
securityPasswordOnlyLocal: Sign in with email and password to use your account password for unlock.
diagnosticsIntro: Tell us about a problem, or share details with support if we ask for them.
diagnosticsErrorReportDesc: Describe what went wrong. We will not include your message text.
diagnosticsErrorReportPlaceholder: What happened? Include what you were doing if you can (e.g. “Messages stay blank after I log in”).
diagnosticsErrorReportIncludeContextDesc: Basic info about your device and app to help us look into the problem.
diagnosticsErrorReportSavedLocally: Report saved on this device. It will be sent when you are back online.
diagnosticsErrorReportFailed: Could not send your report. Try again in a moment.
diagnosticsErrorReportTooShort: Please write at least 10 characters about the problem.
diagnosticsAutoErrorReportDesc: When enabled and you are signed in, unexpected errors may be sent with a short error name and stack snippet. We never send message text or passwords. This is off by default — see Privacy Policy for what may be included.
ageGateSubtitle: Aether is for adults 18+. Confirm your age to continue.
ageGateLegalNote: By continuing you confirm you are 18 or older. Read our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before using the app.
ageGateDenied: You must be 18 or older to use Aether.
authLegalRequired: Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account.
authOAuthLegal: By continuing with Google or Apple you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.
settingsLegalDesc: Policies that describe how Aether works and how we handle your data.
settingsLegalBody: Review these documents any time. They cover age requirements, encryption, location fuzzing, error reports, account deletion, and your rights.
privacyKeyRingNote: These codes keep your messages private. Only share them with support if they ask.
profilePageDesc: Update how you appear on the grid and what you share in chat.
profileSaveFailed: Could not save your profile. Try again.
profileAgeHint: You must be 18 or older to use Aether.
profileLookingForHint: Choose what you are open to — you can pick more than one.
profileHeadlineHint: A short line under your name, e.g. “Coffee and chats”.
profileTagsHint: Pick from the list or add your own below.
profileTagsCustomPlaceholder: Add your own, e.g. Board games, Museums
profileShowOnGrid: Show me on the discovery grid
profileShowOnGridDesc: Others nearby can find your profile.
profilePhotoDesc: Shown on your discovery card. Hidden details are removed when you upload.
profilePhotoDisabled: Profile photo uploads are turned off in media settings below.
profileAllowPhotoUploadsDesc: Lets you add or change your profile picture.
profileAllowAlbumDesc: Shows the album option when you message someone.
profileAllowAlbumMediaDesc: When off, you cannot send photos to private albums in chat.
profileSocialHint: Optional handles shown on your profile. Only usernames — not full URLs.
authLoginSubtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
authPasswordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
authAdminHint: Having trouble? Try resetting your password, or create a new account.
authOfflineNote: You are offline. Some features need an internet connection.
authForgotOffline: You are offline, password reset did not send. Please try again later.
authForgotDesc: Enter the email for your account. If it exists, we will email reset instructions.
authForgotSent: If an account exists for that email, reset instructions were sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
authResetDesc: Please enter the code from your email, then choose a new password.
authResetSuccess: Password updated. You can log in now.
authVerifyBanner: Please verify your email — we sent a confirmation link to your inbox.
authVerifyResendSent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
authVerifyFailed: Verification link is invalid or has expired.
navPanicConfirmBody: This will instantly clear all local app information from this device. Your account will also be marked for permanent deletion.

apiError.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.

apiError.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
